Explain Raft consensus and provide a Go implementation skeleton.

Raft is a consensus algorithm designed to be easy to understand. It is equivalent to Paxos in fault-tolerance and performance.

go 
package raft

type Node struct {
    id        int
    currentTerm int
    votedFor  int
    log       []LogEntry
}

func NewNode(id int) *Node {
    return &Node{id: id, currentTerm: 0, votedFor: -1}
}

Key Raft roles include Leader, Follower, and Candidate.

Role Responsibility
Leader Handles all client requests and log replication
Follower Responds to incoming RPCs from leaders and candidates
